_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/casting/test_return_self_to_hand_on_resolution.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_return_self_if_alone` gains 2 life so the test can see its effects ran, and returns itself only while its caster controls no creature, so the test can flip the condition; `t_return_self_kill` has a target, so the test can make it fizzle; `t_return_self_exiles` prints `exiles_itself` beside the op; `t_return_self_flashback` can be cast with flashback.

cards.name: Test Return Self If Alone
cards.oracle_text: You gain 2 life. If you control no creatures, return Test Return Self If Alone to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Test Return Self Kill
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature. Return Test Return Self Kill to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Test Return Self Exiles
cards.oracle_text: You gain 2 life. Return Test Return Self Exiles to its owner's hand. Exile Test Return Self Exiles.

cards.name: Test Return Self Flashback
cards.oracle_text:
You gain 2 life. Return Test Return Self Flashback to its owner's hand.
Flashback {W}
